title: RF device position (v0)
description: Estimated position of one device, published by the WBT Console on detection/rf/positions when the estimate has new readings (at most every few seconds per device, at least every 30 s while it is still heard). Draft: replaced by the fusion standard when it is published (analytics/src/rfanalytics/formats.py).

timestamp.description: UTC time of the newest reading the estimate uses.

name.description: SSID, Bluetooth name or TPMS model, when known.

mark.description: Operator's mark: friendly (team device) or priority (device of interest).

x_ft.description: Site floor-plan coordinates in feet (y points down on the plan).

lat.description: WGS84; present once the site is geo-referenced.

error_ft.description: Median error measured by calibration (leave-one-out); null when not calibrated.

error_m.description: error_ft in metres combined with the geo-reference fit; with lat/lon only.

calibrated.description: False: default model, no measured accuracy.

heard_by.description: Nodes whose readings placed the device. Two nodes fix a curve rather than a point.
